summary_en: The proper calendar of the dioceses of Ecuador is approved (bare line under 'Calendaria particularia'); the same protocol confirms the Spanish translation of the Proprium Missarum (p. 26).
excerpt: Aequatoriae Dioeceses, 12 decembris 1986 (Prot. 862/86).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Clifton (England) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the English text of the Proprium Missarum and Liturgiae Horarum (p. 27).
excerpt: Cliftoniensis, 29 novembris 1986 (Prot. 1696/84).

summary_en: The diocese of Minorca (Spain) may insert into its proper calendar the celebrations of St Catherine Thomas, virgin, on 28 July and of Blessed Raymond Llull on 27 November, both as memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out. The same protocol confirms the Latin, Catalan and Spanish texts of the Proprium (p. 28).
excerpt: Minoricensis, 15 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1070/86): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctae Catharinae Thomas, virginis, die 28 iulii, et celebratio beati Raimundi Llull, die 27 novembris, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeant, quotannis, gradu memoriae peragendae.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Bari (Italy) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the Latin and Italian texts of the Proprium Missarum and Liturgiae Horarum (p. 28).
excerpt: Barensis, 18 decembris 1986 (Prot. 438/86).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the united dioceses of Viterbo, Tuscania, Civita Castellana, Acquapendente and Bagnoregio (Italy) is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Viterbiensis-Tuscanensis-Faliscodunensis-Aquipendiensis-Balneoregiensis, 12 decembris 1986 (Prot. 793/86).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Clementina Nengapeta Anuarite, virgo et martyr

summary_en: The dioceses of Zaire may insert into the national proper calendar the celebration of Blessed Marie-Clementine Nengapeta Anuarite, virgin and martyr, on 1 December each year with the rank of feast.
excerpt: Dioeceses Zairenses, 19 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1219/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Clementinae Nengapeta Anuarite, virginis et martyris in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Nationis inseri valeat quotannis die 1 decembris gradu festi peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Conventualium, Provincia « Our Lady of Consolation » in Statibus Unitis Americae

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Conventual Franciscan Province 'Our Lady of Consolation' (United States) the feast of the Blessed Virgin Mary Consoler of the Afflicted, patroness of the Province, is transferred from 1 October to 25 May.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Conventualium, 17 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1208/86): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio Provinciae “Our Lady of Consolation” in Statibus Unitis Americae celebratio Festi Beatae Mariae Virginis Consolatricis Afflictorum, eiusdem Provinciae Patronae, a die primo octobris ad diem vicesimum quintum maii transferri valeat.

summary_en: The election of Blessed John Grande, religious, as patron before God of the diocese of Asidonia-Jerez (Spain) is confirmed.
excerpt: Assidonensis-Ierezensis, 10 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1097/86): confirmatur electio beati Ioannis Grande, religiosi, apud Deum Patroni dioecesis Assidonensis-Ierezensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de Setefilla »

summary_en: Archdiocese of Seville (Spain): the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nuestra Señora de Setefilla' as patroness before God of the town of Lora del Río and of the neighbouring places is confirmed; a local (town) patron, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Hispalensis, 5 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1175/86): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de Setefilla » civitatis vulgo dictae Lora del Rio et locorum propinquorum apud Deum Patronae.

summary_en: Diocese of La Spezia-Sarzana-Brugnato (Italy): the election of St Leopold Mandić, priest, as patron before God of the parish community of St Paul in the city of La Spezia is confirmed; a single parish, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Spediensis-Sarzanensis-Brugnatensis, 19 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1214/86): confirmatur electio Sancti Leopoldi Mandic, presbyteri, communitatis paroecialis Sancti Pauli in civitate Spediensi Patroni apud Deum.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of San Jose in California (United States) is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Sanctus Iosephus in California, 11 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 1101/86).

summary_en: The diocese of Aachen (Germany) may insert into its proper calendar St Arnold on 18 July and Blessed Pauline von Mallinckrodt, virgin, on 30 April, both as optional memorials, and may transfer the celebration of St Benedict of Aniane, abbot, from 12 to 11 February; three celebrations named, so none singled out. The same protocol confirms the German text of the collect and second reading for St Arnold (p. 170).
excerpt: Aquisgranensis, 10 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 187/87): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeant sequentes celebrationes: — Sancti Arnoldi, quotannis die 18 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda; — Beatae Paulinae de Mallinckrodt, virginis, quotannis die 30 aprilis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda. Conceditur etiam ut celebratio Sancti Benedicti Anianensis, abbatis, a die 12 ad diem 11 mensis februarii transferri possit.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Forlì-Bertinoro (Italy) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the Latin and Italian texts of the Proprium Missarum and Liturgiae Horarum (p. 170).
excerpt: Foroliviensis-Brittinoriensis, 13 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 1129/86).

target.institute: Abbatia Montisvirginis

summary_en: For five years, in the sanctuary of the Abbey of Montevergine (Italy), on 24 June First Vespers of the solemnity of St William, abbot, may be celebrated in place of Second Vespers of the solemnity of the Nativity of St John the Baptist; an occurrence ruling for one sanctuary, five-year term.
excerpt: Abbatia Montisvirginis, 17 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 236/87): conceditur ad quinquennium ut in sanctuario Abbatiae Montisvirginis die 24 iunii celebrari possint Vesperae I sollemnitatis Sancti Gulielmi, abbatis, loco Vesperarum II sollemnitatis « In nativitate Sancti Ioannis Baptistae ».

summary_en: Colombia: the election of St Gabriel the Archangel as patron before God of the soldiers of the Colombian army assigned to the Telecommunications corps is confirmed; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Columbia, 31 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 279/87): confirmatur electio Sancti Gabrielis Archangeli Patroni apud Deum militum ex Columbiano exercitu ordini Telecommunicationum addictorum.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Nossa Senhora das Dores »

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nossa Senhora das Dores' as patroness before God of the diocese of Limeira (Brazil) is confirmed.
excerpt: Limeirensis, 13 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 1181/86): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nossa Senhora das Dores » apud Deum Patronae dioecesis Limeirensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Dominae Nostrae Vulneratae »

summary_en: Archdiocese of Split-Makarska (Yugoslavia, today Croatia): in the church-sanctuary of St Peter the Apostle in the city of Split the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Our Wounded Lady' may be kept on 23 January each year with the rank of feast; a single church, hence level 'other'. The same protocol confirms the Latin and Croatian texts of the Mass and Office (p. 214).
excerpt: Spalatensis - Macarscensis, 14 februarii 1987 (Prot. 891/86): conceditur ut in ecclesia-sanctuario Sancti Petri apostoli, in civitate Spalatensi exstructa, celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Dominae Nostre Vulneratae » quotannis die 23 ianuarii gradu festi peragi possit.

target.institute: Societas Sancti Francisci Salesii

summary_en: The Salesians of Don Bosco may celebrate Blesseds Louis Versiglia, bishop, and Callistus Caravario, priest, martyrs, as an obligatory memorial, and may insert St Leonard Murialdo, priest, into the proper calendar of the Society on 19 May as an optional memorial; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Societas Sancti Francisci Salesii, 4 martii 1987 (Prot. 388/87): conceditur ut: — celebratio Beatorum Aloisii Versiglia, episcopi, et Callisti Caravario, presbyteri, martyrum, gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi possit; — celebratio Sancti Leonardi Murialdo, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Societatis inseri valeat, quotannis die 19 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Barcelona (Spain) may insert the celebration of Blessed Joseph Manyanet Vives, priest, into its proper calendar on 16 December each year as an optional memorial. The protocol is printed '373/86' here but '373/87' on the text-confirmation line of the same date on p. 280, so the number is uncertain.
excerpt: Barcinonensis, 10 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 373/86): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Iosephi Manyanet Vives, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 16 decembris, gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1987 only: in the archdiocese of Bari-Bitonto (Italy), in which the ninth centenary of the translation of St Nicholas from Myra to Bari is solemnly commemorated, the celebration of the Translation may be kept on 9 May 1987 with the rank of solemnity.
excerpt: Barensis - Bituntina, 21 martii 1987 (Prot. 553/87): conceditur ut vertente hoc anno 1987, in quo IX expletum saeculum a Translatione e Myra ad Barium Sancti Nicolai episcopi sollemniter commemoratur, celebratio liturgica ipsius Translationis die 9 maii anni 1987 proxime venturo gradu sollemnitatis peragi possit.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Military Ordinariate of Belgium is approved (bare line); a military ordinariate, recorded at level 'other'.
excerpt: Belgium, Ordinariatus Castrensis, 3 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 277/87).

summary_en: The diocese of Urgell (Spain) may insert the celebration of Blessed Joseph Manyanet Vives, priest, into its proper calendar on 16 December each year as an optional memorial; the same protocol confirms the texts of the Mass and Office (p. 280).
excerpt: Urgellensis, 10 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 243/87): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Iosephi Manyanet Vives, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 16 decembris, gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Vic (Spain) may insert the celebration of Blessed Joseph Manyanet Vives, priest, into its proper calendar on 16 December each year as an optional memorial; the same protocol confirms the texts of the Mass and Office (p. 280).
excerpt: Vicensis, 10 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 615/87): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Iosephi Manyanet Vives, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 16 decembris, gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Congregatio Filiorum Sacrae Familiae

summary_en: In the Congregation of the Sons of the Holy Family the celebration of Blessed Joseph Manyanet Vives, priest, its founder, is transferred from 17 December to 16 December, with the rank of feast.
excerpt: Congregatio Filiorum Sacrae Familiae, 10 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 384/87): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Iosephi Manyanet Vives, presbyteri, eiusdem Congregationis Fundatoris, a die 17 decembris ad praecedentem diem 16 eiusdem mensis transferatur, quotannis gradu Festi peragenda.

target.institute: Institutum saeculare « Hermandad de sacerdotes operarios Diocesanos »

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Emmanuel Domingo y Sol, presbyter

summary_en: The secular institute 'Hermandad de sacerdotes operarios Diocesanos' may celebrate Blessed Emmanuel Domingo y Sol, priest, its founder, in its churches on 29 January each year with the rank of feast.
excerpt: Institutum saeculare « Hermandad de sacerdotes operarios Diocesanos », 1 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 261/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Emmanuelis Domingo y Sol, presbyteri, Fundatoris, in ecclesiis eiusdem Instituti quotannis die 29 ianuarii gradu festi peragi valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may insert Blesseds Maria Pilar of St Francis Borgia, Teresa of the Child Jesus and Maria Angeles of St Joseph, virgins and martyrs, into the proper calendar of the Order on 24 July as an optional memorial, and may transfer Blessed John Soreth, priest, from 24 July to 27 July; two celebrations named, so none singled out (the Soreth date was moved again on 11 November 1987 under the same protocol, see N1987-284-87-2).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 1 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 284/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatarum Mariae Pilar a Sancto Francisco Borgia, Teresiae a Iesu Infante et Mariae Angeles a Sancto Ioseph, virginum et martyrum, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 24 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda. Conceditur insuper ut in praedicto Calendario proprio celebratio Beati Ioannis Soreth, presbyteri, a die 24 iulii ad diem 27 iulii transferri possit.

target.institute: Congregatio Sororum S. Augustini in Polonia

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Congregation of the Sisters of St Augustine in Poland is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum S. Augustini in Polonia, 27 martii 1987 (Prot. 766/86).

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virgo

summary_en: Cuba: the election of St Teresa of Jesus Jornet Ibars, virgin, as patroness before God of the elderly of Cuba is confirmed; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Cuba, 1 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 594/87): confirmatur electio Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virginis, Patronae apud Deum senum Cubae.

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1989 only: because the solemnity of St Joseph (19 March) coincides with Palm Sunday in 1989, it is anticipated to Saturday 18 March in accordance with n. 60 of the General Norms; where it is not a holy day of obligation the Bishops' Conference may transfer it to another day outside Lent (n. 56). Printed as a notice of the Congregation signed by the Secretary, without protocol number or date.
excerpt: Anno 1989 habebitur occurrentia sollemnitatis S. Ioseph (die 19 martii) cum Dominica in Palmis de Passione Domini et sollemnitatis Annuntiationis Domini (die 25 martii) cum Sabbato Sancto. [...] Iuxta n. 60 Normarum universalium de anno liturgico et de calendario, sollemnitas S. Ioseph anticipatur sabbato die 18 martii.

summary_en: Ruling for 1989 with a standing rule: in 1989 the solemnity of the Annunciation (25 March, Holy Saturday) is celebrated on Monday 3 April, after the Second Sunday of Easter; and from then on, whenever the Annunciation falls on a day of Holy Week, it is always to be transferred to the Monday after the Second Sunday of Easter. Printed as a notice of the Congregation without protocol number or date.
excerpt: Sollemnitas Annuntiationis Domini celebranda erit die 3 aprilis, feria II post Dominicam II Paschae. Ab illa vice ac deinceps ipsa sollemnitas, quotiescumque occurrit aliquo die Maioris Hebdomadae, semper ad feriam II post Dominicam II Paschae erit transferenda.

summary_en: In the dioceses of Canada the celebration of St Marguerite Bourgeoys may be kept on 12 January each year as an obligatory memorial; recorded as a grade change on the assumption that the celebration was already in the Canadian calendar at a lower rank, which the line does not state.
excerpt: Canadiae dioeceses, 25 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 662/87): conceditur ut in dioecesibus Canadiae celebratio Sanctae Margaritae Bourgeoys quotannis die 12 ianuarii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Saint-Hyacinthe (Canada) is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Sanctus Hyacinthus, 25 maii 1987 (Prot. 651/87).

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia Benedicta a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyr

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein), martyr, into the proper calendar of the Order on 9 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 5 maii 1987 (Prot. 297/87): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyris, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 9 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum

summary_en: The Capuchins may transfer the anniversary of the dedication of their conventual church at Besançon (France) from 4 October to the following day, 5 October; a single church.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, 8 maii 1987 (Proot. 709/87): conceditur ut celebratio anniversaria dedicationis ecclesiae conventualis Bisuntinae a die 4 octobris ad sequentem diem 5 eiusdem mensis transferri possit.

summary_en: In the diocesan calendar of Alba Iulia (Romania), for pastoral reasons, the feast of St Matthias, Apostle, is transferred from 14 May to 24 February, the feast of the Visitation from 31 May to 2 July and the memorial of St Elizabeth of Hungary from 17 to 19 November; three celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Alba Iuliensis, 2 iulii 1987 (Prot. 832/87): conceditur ut, attentis rationibus pastoralibus, celebrationes quae sequuntur, in Calendario dioecesis exstantes, transferri valeant: — Festum S. Matthiae, Apostoli, a die 14 maii ad diem 24 februarii; — Festum « In Visitatione BMV » a die 31 maii ad diem 2 iulii; — Memoria S. Elisabeth Hungariae, religiosae, a die 17 novembris ad diem 19 eiusdem mensis.

summary_en: The diocese of Augsburg (Germany) may insert into its proper calendar Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, on 3 November and Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross, martyr, on 9 August, both as optional memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Augustana Vindelicorum, 10 iulii 1987 (Prot. 918/87): conceditur ut celebrationes Beatorum Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, die 3 novembris, et Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce, martyris, die 9 augusti, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeant quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragendae.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Emmanuel Domingo y Sol, presbyter

summary_en: In the diocese of Tortosa (Spain) the celebration of Blessed Emmanuel Domingo y Sol, priest, may be kept on 29 January each year as an obligatory memorial in the episcopal city and as an optional memorial in the rest of the diocese; two ranks printed, so grade left null.
excerpt: Dertosensis, 2 iunii 1987 (Prot. 788/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Emmanuelis Doming y Sol, presbyteri, quotannis, die 29 ianuarii, gradu memoriae obligatoriae in civitate episcopali, gradu vero memoriae ad libitum in ceteris dioecesis partibus peragi valeat.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Freiburg (Germany) may insert into its calendar Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross, martyr, on 9 August and Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, on 3 November, both as optional memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out. The page prints the date as '23 iunii 197' and the protocol as '63/7' (both evidently truncated: the Summarium covers 16 May-31 July 1987), so the date is left null and the protocol is given as printed.
excerpt: Friburgensis, 23 iunii 197 (Prot. 63/7): conceditur ut celebrationes Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce, martyris, die 9 augusti, necnon Beati Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, die 3 novembris, in Calendarium archidioecesis inseri valeant, quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragendae.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia Benedicta a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyr

summary_en: The dioceses of the Netherlands may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein) into the calendar of the Dutch dioceses on 9 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Hollandiae dioeceses, 5 iunii 1987 (Prot. 808/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae Benedictae (Edith Stein) in Calendarium dioecesium Hollandiae inseri valeat, quotannis die 9 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Genoa (Italy) may insert the celebration of Blessed Benedicta Cambiagio Frassinello into its calendar on 10 May each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ianuensis, 20 iulii 1987 (Prot. 942/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Benedictae Cambiagio Frassinello, in Calendarium Archidioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 10 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Pavia (Italy) may insert the celebration of Blessed Benedicta Cambiagio Frassinello into its calendar on 10 May each year as an optional memorial; the same protocol confirms the Italian text of the collect and second reading (p. 1036).
excerpt: Papiensis, 1 iunii 1987 (Prot. 787/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Benedictae Cambiagio Frassinello, in Calendarium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 10 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Orvieto-Todi (Italy) is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Urbevetana - Tudertina, 26 iunii 1987 (Prot. 713/87).

target.institute: « Confraternity of Christ the eternal high priest »

celebration.name_latin: Dominus noster Iesus Christus Summus et Aeternus Sacerdos

summary_en: The 'Confraternity of Christ the eternal high priest' (Australia) may celebrate Our Lord Jesus Christ, Eternal High Priest, in its churches each year on the Thursday after Pentecost with the rank of feast; an association, hence level 'other'. The same protocol confirms the Latin text of the Office (p. 1037).
excerpt: « Confraternity of Christ the eternal high priest », 10 iulii 1987 (Prot. 196/86): conceditur ut celebratio Domini nostri Iesu Christi Summi et Aeterni Sacerdotis in ecclesiis eiusdem Confraternitatis quotannis feria quinta post Pentecosten gradu festi peragi valeat.

target.institute: Institutum Sororum Benedictinarum a Providentia

summary_en: In the Institute of the Benedictine Sisters of Providence the celebration of Blessed Benedicta Cambiagio Frassinello is transferred from 21 March to 10 May.
excerpt: Institutum Sororum Benedictinarum a Providentia, 22 iunii 1987 (Prot. 859/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Benedictae Cambiagio Frassinello a die 21 martii ad diem 10 maii transferri valeat.

target.institute: Ordo beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede

summary_en: For five years the Order of Our Lady of Mercy may celebrate the votive Mass of Our Lady of Mercy in its churches and in those of religious aggregated to it on the days on which the Saturday Mass of the BVM is permitted (General Norms n. 15) and on the Saturdays of Advent (except 17-24 December) and of Easter time; a standing votive-Mass concession on fixed weekdays, recorded as 'other'.
excerpt: Ordo beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede, 24 iunii 1987 (Prot. 866/87): conceditur ad quinquennium ut in ecclesiis eiusdem Ordinis, necnon in ecclesiis religiosarum, quae ipsi Ordini sunt aggregatae, celebrari valeat Missa votiva de beata Maria Virgine de Mercede diebus quibus permittitur Missa de Sancta Maria in sabbato (« Normae universales de anno liturgico et de calendario », n. 15) atque sabbatis temporis Adventus (exceptis diebus a 17 ad 24 decembris inclusive) et temporis Paschae.

summary_en: Archdiocese of Genoa-Bobbio (Italy): the celebration of St Tarsicius, titular and patron of the college of that name, and of St Cecilia, titular and patroness of the college of that name, may be kept each year with the rank of solemnity for the members of those colleges; two celebrations for two institutions, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Ianuensis-Bobiensis, 1 septembris 1987 (Prot. 1060/87): conceditur ut celebratio S. Tarsicii, titularis ac Patroni Collegii eiusdem nominis atque celebratio S. Caeciliae, titularis ac Patronae Collegii eiusdem nominis, quotannis pro Collegiorum praedictorum membris gradu sollemnitatis peragi valeant.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Nocera Inferiore-Sarno (Italy) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the Italian text of the Proprium Missarum (p. 1152).
excerpt: Nucerina Paganorum - Sarnensis, 3 septembris 1987 (Prot. 1022/87).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Maria SS.ma di sotto gli Organi »

summary_en: The archdiocese of Pisa (Italy) may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Maria SS.ma di sotto gli Organi' into its proper calendar on 25 October each year, as a feast in the cathedral and as an obligatory memorial throughout the diocese; two ranks printed, so grade left null.
excerpt: Pisana, 29 septembris 1987 (Prot. 1131/87): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Maria SS.ma di sotto gli Organi » in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 octobris in ecclesia cathedrali gradu festi in universa dioecesi gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia a Iesu « de los Andes », virgo

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa of Jesus 'de los Andes', virgin, into the proper calendar of the Order on 13 July each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo, 26 septembris 1987 (Prot. 1113/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae a Iesu « de los Andes », virginis, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 13 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum, Provincia Poloniae

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Polish Province of the Order of Preachers is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum, Provincia Poloniae, 5 augusti 1987 (Prot. 751/87).

target.institute: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, Congregatio Austriaca

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Austrian Congregation of the Order of St Benedict is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the Latin and German texts of the Proprium Missarum for the monasteries of the Congregation (p. 1152).
excerpt: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, Congregatio Austriaca, 4 septembris 1987 (Prot. 312/83).

summary_en: Diocese of La Spezia-Sarzana-Brugnato (Italy): the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary 'Peregrina' as patroness before God of the parish community of the cathedral church of La Spezia is confirmed; a single parish, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Spediensis - Sarzanensis - Brugnatensis, 26 septembris 1987 (Prot. 1121/87): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis « Peregrinae » Patronae apud Deum communitatis paroecialis ecclesiae cathedralis Spediensis.

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Bernardus, Maria et Gratia, martyres

summary_en: Archdiocese of Valencia (Spain): the election of Sts Bernard, Mary and Grace, martyrs, as patrons before God of the town of Alzira is confirmed; a town patron, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Valentina, 20 augusti 1987 (Prot. 1020/87): confirmatur electio Sanctorum Bernardi, Mariae et Gratiae, martyrum in Patronos apud Deum civitatis v.d. « Alzira ».

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virgo

summary_en: Venezuela: the election of St Teresa of Jesus Jornet Ibars, virgin, as patroness before God of the elderly of Venezuela is confirmed; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Venetiola, 6 augusti 1987 (Prot. 997/87): confirmatur electio Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virginis, Patronae apud Deum Senum Venetiolae.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia a Iesu « de los Andes », virgo

summary_en: The dioceses of Chile may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa of Jesus 'de los Andes', virgin, of the Order of Discalced Carmelites, into the national proper calendar on 13 July each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Chiliae dioeceses, 6 octobris 1987 (Prot. 965/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae a Iesu « de los Andes », virginis ex Ordine Carmelitarum Discalceatorum, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 13 iulii, gradu memoriae ad libitum, peragenda.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Freiburg (Germany) may insert the celebration of Blessed Ulrika Nisch, virgin (printed 'Lisch'), into its proper calendar on 8 May each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Friburgensis, 10 novembris 1987 1987 (Prot. 1223/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Ulricae Lisch, virginis, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 8 maii, gradu memoriae ad libitum, peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Würzburg (Germany) may insert into its proper calendar Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, on 3 November and Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross, martyr, on 9 August, both as optional memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Herbipolensis, 10 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1218/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, die 3 novembris quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda necnon celebratio Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce, martyris, die 9 augusti quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeant.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Georgius Matulaitis seu Matulewicz, episcopus

summary_en: In the dioceses of Lithuania the celebration of Blessed George Matulaitis (Matulewicz), bishop, may be transferred from 27 January to 12 July, to be kept each year as an obligatory memorial; protocol printed with a hyphen ('1189-87').
excerpt: Lituaniae dioeceses, 17 octobris 1987 (Prot. 1189-87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Georgii Matulaitis seu Matulewicz, episcopi, a die 27 ianuarii ad diem 12 iulii transferri possit, quotannis gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Munich and Freising (Germany) may insert into its proper calendar Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, on 3 November and Blessed Mary Theresa of Jesus Gerhardinger, virgin, on 9 May, both as obligatory memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Monacensis et Frisingensis, 20 octobris 1987 (Prot. 1177/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, quotannis die 3 novembris, gradu memoria obligatoriae peragenda, necnon celebratio Beatae Mariae Teresiae a Iesu Gerhardinger, virginis quotannis die 9 maii, gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeant.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Rouen-Le Havre (France) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the French text of the Proprium Missarum and Liturgiae Horarum (p. 1213).
excerpt: Rothomagensis - Portus Gratiae, 7 octobris 1987 (Prot. 306/87).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Soissons-Laon-Saint-Quentin (France) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the Latin text of the Proprium Missarum and Liturgiae Horarum (p. 1213).
excerpt: Suessionensis - Laudunensis - Sanquintinensis, 8 septembris 1987 (Prot. CD 128/83).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Carolina Kozka, virgo et martyr

summary_en: The diocese of Tarnów (Poland) may insert the celebration of Blessed Karolina Kózka into its proper calendar on 18 November each year, as an obligatory memorial throughout the diocese and as a feast in the cathedral basilica and in the parish church of Zabawa where her body rests; two ranks printed, so grade left null.
excerpt: Tarnoviensis, 13 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1241/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Carolinae Kozka in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 18 novembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae in universa dioecesi, gradu vero festi in Basilica Cathedrali et in ecclesia paroeciali loci v. d. « Zabawa », ubi corpus eiusdem Beatae religiose asservatur, peragenda.

target.institute: Congregatio Canonicorum Regularium S. Augustini Lateranensium Austriaca

celebration.name_latin: Ss. Michael, Gabriel et Raphael, Archangeli

summary_en: In the monastery of Klosterneuburg (Austria) the Austrian Congregation of the Canons Regular of the Lateran may celebrate Sts Michael, Gabriel and Raphael, Archangels, on 29 September each year with the rank of solemnity; a single monastery.
excerpt: Congregatio Canonicorum Regularium S. Augustini Lateranensium Austriaca, 10 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1220/87): conceditur ut celebratio Ss. Michaëlis, Gabrielis et Raphaëlis, Archangelorum, in Monasterio Claustroneuburgensi quotannis die 29 septembris, gradu sollemnitatis, peragi valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may transfer the celebration of Blessed John Soreth, priest, from 27 July to 28 July; a second act under the same protocol as the 1 April 1987 change (N1987-284-87), which had moved him from 24 to 27 July.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 11 novembris 1987 (Prot. 284/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ioannis Soreth, presbyteri, a die 27 iulii ad diem 28 iulii transferri possit.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Laurentius Ruiz et Socii, martyres

summary_en: The Order of Preachers may celebrate St Lawrence Ruiz and companions, martyrs, throughout the Order on 28 September each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum, 30 octobris 1987 (Prot. 1129/87): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Laurentii Ruiz et Sociorum, martyrum, in universo Ordine quotannis die 28 septembris, gradu memoriae obligatoriae, peragi possit.

target.institute: Sorores a caritate S. Crucis de Ingenbohl

summary_en: The Sisters of Charity of the Holy Cross of Ingenbohl (Switzerland) may insert the celebration of Blessed Ulrika Nisch, virgin (printed 'Nish'), into their proper calendar on 8 May each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Sorores a caritate S. Crucis de Ingenbohl, 10 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1222/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Ulricae Nish, virginis, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 8 maii, gradu memoriae obligatoriae, peragenda.

target.institute: Sorores v.d. « Dominicaines de Béthanie »

summary_en: The 'Dominicaines de Béthanie' may insert the celebration of Sts Martha, Mary and Lazarus into their proper calendar on 29 July each year with the rank of feast; the same protocol confirms the French text of the Mass and Office (p. 1215).
excerpt: Sorores v.d. « Dominicaines de Béthanie », 1 octobris 1987 (Prot. 1054/87): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctorum Marthae, Mariae et Lazari in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 29 iulii gradu festi peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo in caelum Assumpta

summary_en: Eparchy of Prešov (Czechoslovakia, today Slovakia): the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary Assumed into Heaven as patroness before God of the parish community of the same title in Lutina is confirmed; a single parish, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Prešoviensis, 3 octobris 1987 (Prot. 180/87): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis in caelum Assumptae Patronae apud Deum communitatis paroecialis eiusdem tituli in loco v.d. « Lutina ».
